en: A colorized vintage view of an Italian piazza. On the left is an ornate church façade with a domed roof behind it, and adjoining historic buildings with arched doorways and balconies. In the right foreground stands a large baroque fountain with multiple tiers and statues, topped by a figure holding a trident. A few pedestrians walk across the open square. The caption at the top right reads "TRENTO - Casa Rella".
